RQ1=tomato; RQ2=Route B (homogeneous patch proxy) primary; RQ3=root-zone soil moisture + crop water status; RQ4=chlorophyll fluorescence, stomatal conductance, canopy/leaf temperature, spectral reflectance; RQ5=90% PI coverage; RQ6=water-use efficiency; RQ7=RQ5 target met on validation set; RQ8=PlanetScope secured; RQ9=co-located seasonal campaign; RQ10=TRL 3-4; all ten operator-confirmed

RISK-01 through RISK-10: ten hazards across four categories (data_access: RISK-01/02/03; validation: RISK-04/05/06; model_complexity: RISK-07/08/09; operationalisation: RISK-10) with stated probabilities, impacts, mitigations and contingencies, all grounded in METH-RISK-002

Six of ten risks are high impact (RISK-01, RISK-04, RISK-05, RISK-06, RISK-07, RISK-08); four with structural methodology mitigations; one (RISK-01) resolved by RQ8 pre-proposal; no risk simultaneously high probability and high impact without a credible mitigation

Uncertainty-aware AquaCrop calibration (RISK-08 mitigation) builds on established methods in the literature, doi:10.1016/j.envsoft.2022.105556 cited in the project risk register; the method is not attributed to Dr. Rositsa Cholakova as her original work
